setup: A pyramid has a base of area \([[base]]\) square units and a height of \([[height]]\) units.

steps.say: The prism with the same base and height would have volume base times height, so the base \([[base]]\) and the height \([[height]]\) together give that comparison figure.
A pyramid fills one third of that prism, for any pyramid and not only the square-based ones, so the volume is a third of \([[base]] \times [[height]]\).

answer: So the pyramid's volume is \([[volume]]\) cubic units.
